## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Probabilistic Hazard Assessment"`

```{r}
#| include: false
.ID.BASE <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  AEPTable,
  "hazard slide",
  target = .ID.BASE,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
  base = TRUE
)
.ID.BASE <- ID.target
```

:::{.panel-tabset }

### Uniform Hazard Spectra

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
.SITE <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
.STEM <- if (is.character(.SITE) && length(.SITE) == 1L) paste0(tolower(.SITE), "-") else ""
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/UHS.TR.qmd",
  stem = paste0(.STEM, "uhs-tr"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(ID.target = .ID.BASE, siteID.target = .SITE),
  root = root
)
rm(list = intersect(c(
  ".SITE", ".STEM"
), ls()))
```

### PoE (Total)

{{< include /_fig/POE.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(AEPSTable) && nrow(AEPSTable)) {
  .SITE <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
  .STEM <- if (is.character(.SITE) && length(.SITE) == 1L) paste0(tolower(.SITE), "-") else ""
  cat("\n### PoE (By Source)\n\n")
  ID.target <- .ID.BASE
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/POES.qmd", stem = paste0(.STEM, "poes"), labels = "rewrite", root = root)
  rm(.SITE, .STEM)
}
```
